baseline.input: external Git checkout; committed objects only

corrections.reason: The older inventory matched only registration variable names ending in Rule; NoWebpackLoaderSyntax also belongs to the root catalog.

scope: Every builtin registration and its option schema is resolved from committed baseline source without executing Go.
Go test paths and commands refer only to the external frozen oracle. They are migration input, never a candidate runtime dependency.
Schemas include schema-declared defaults. Defaults and behavior implemented in rule bodies remain covered by source hashes and oracle test references.
No test, port, behavior compatibility or performance result is claimed by this inventory.
